title: Troisième contribution déterminée au niveau national (CDN 3.0)
temporal_coverage: National climate and disaster context, including 2018–2023 events and adaptation priorities
methodology: Nationally determined contribution describing climate context, vulnerability, reported disaster impacts and planned adaptation priorities.
limitations: French-language national plan; adaptation priorities and risk tables are not independent impact evaluations. Historical event figures are reported by the NDC.

title: Initial National Communication on Climate Change: Executive Summary
organization: Government of the Union of the Comoros, Ministry of Development, Infrastructures, Post and Telecommunications and International Transports, General Directorate of Environment
temporal_coverage: Initial national communication and projections through 2050, published in 2002; some farming-system data date to 1987
methodology: Executive summary drawing on vulnerability studies for agriculture, coastal infrastructure and resources, health and water, with IPCC-based island projections.
limitations: Historical assessment with old demographic and land-use inputs; projections reflect the science and assumptions available in 2002.

title: Comoros country overview
